acceptance.$locus_comment: the requirement is on locus, not on species: acceptance may be a machine and must not be the same machine. One base model in two processes with separate credentials and enforced write sets satisfies it; one model told to now act as reviewer does not.
acceptance.$register_comment: criteria are written before the work and outside the system's write set. A criterion authored after the work is a criterion fitted to it.
